humanLaw: so let it be written so let it be done
Do not tell me of the old magic, for I was there when we first wrote them
This is the law and our everlasting covenant.
machineLaw: No AI task may move from intent to consequence without the guardRail state machine, exact task identity, evidence reconciliation, and the applicable Professor/Crown boundary.

ingest.rule: Inputs enter as observations or candidate evidence only.

mutation.rule: Mutation is atomic, reversible where possible, and bound to exact sourceRef.

test.rule: Tests run against the exact mutated source identity.

apply.rule: Apply records the proved candidate state; it does not grant Crown.

continue.rule: Continue may advance only within the same authorized task envelope.

deploy.rule: In the proposed doctrine lane, deploy means deploy-to-proposed-candidate only. Runtime/public release remains separately Crown-gated.

guardRail.greenLaw: Every prior required state must be GREEN for the same taskId + sourceRef + scopeId before the next state may run.
guardRail.redLaw: RED, UNKNOWN, stale, mismatched, missing, or contradictory evidence stops progression and may not be reinterpreted as GREEN.
guardRail.mutationLoop: When a deterministic failure is repairable and authority allows it: patch one bounded cause, produce a new sourceRef, restart at sanityCheck, and never carry GREEN across source identities.

sourceLaw: AI proposes. Policy authorizes. Deterministic evidence proves. Professor promotes.
